node.title: In Net::DNS::RR what is the 'can' method?
node.author: Lotus1
node.doctext:
This is from the examples section of [mod://Net::DNS] :

use Net::DNS; my $res = Net::DNS::Resolver->new; my $reply = $res->search("www.example.com", "A"); if ($reply) { foreach my $rr ($reply->answer) { print $rr->address, "\n" if $rr->can("address"); } } else { warn "query failed: ", $res->errorstring, "\n"; }

The search method in the [mod://Net::DNS::Resolver|resolver] returns a [mod://Net::DNS::Packet|packet object]. Then the 'answer' method of that (from Net::DNS::Packet) "Returns a list of Net::DNS::RR objects representing the answer section of the packet." I've looked through the documentation for [mod://Net::DNS::RR] and the module sourch but can't find the description of what the 'can' method is. The example runs without errors while using strict and warnings. Any suggestions?
